notes.title: Relaxing sandbox game Ale and Tale Tavern expands with new customization options
notes.notes:
It's definitely cliche at this point, but there's a reason every fantasy adventure starts at the local tavern. Not only is it a lively meeting place, but it's filled with colorful characters, loose lips, and plenty of quests to set you on your way. Whether it's Skyrim's Bannered Mare or The Witcher 3's White Orchard Inn, the videogame tavern is the place to be. What if, then, instead of being the adventurer wandering in, you were the one cleaning the flagons behind the bar? This is exactly what Ale and Tale Tavern is all about, as it turns your attention to managing the inn so many adventurers call home. With a huge new update focused on decorating your business, and a sizable Steam discount, now's the ideal time to give it a shot.

notes.title: Comfy sandbox game Ale and Tale Tavern grows its inn with a free update and sale
notes.notes:

Best of all, you can grab the game dirt cheap right now, as developer Scienart Games has massively expanded Ale and Tale Tavern with a free update.

notes.title: Cozy co-op sandbox game Ale and Tale Tavern hits its lowest price on Steam
notes.notes:
For as open-ended as they are, having a central goal is what makes the best sandbox games tick, whether it's running your farm in Stardew Valley or conquering the hardest bosses in Terraria. One particularly popular fantasy, it seems, is running a tavern - that blend of cozy and busy, combined with the soothing bustle of a rural setting. One of 2024's best such offerings is bar management sim Ale and Tale Tavern, and if you and your friends are on the hunt for your next co-op game, you can get it now at its lowest price yet since launch.

notes.title: Cozy management sim Ale and Tale Tavern expands with a surprisingly cute update
notes.notes:
The urge to pack it all up and move to the countryside is a very real one. Every once in a while I wonder what life would be like if my day-to-day wasn't spent in front of a computer screen, and ironically a lot of videogames offer just that. Between Valheim, Stardew Valley, and Travellers Rest it's easy to adopt the rural lifestyle, but none do it quite like Ale and Tale Tavern. This open-world management sim is quietly one of the best in genre, and now's the time to get involved. Not only is the full game 25% off for a limited time, but a new update overhauls much of what was already there.

notes.title: Ale and Tale Tavern launches, serves tankard full of cozy co-op vibes
notes.notes:
The cozy fantasy subgenre has been staging a quiet revolution in recent years, especially in the literature sphere. Novels like Legends and Lattes, Can't Spell Treason Without Tea, and The Very Secret Society of Irregular Witches have become behemoths, and the videogame world is not immune to the charms of these vibes. We've had lots of cozy games arrive on the scene, like Stardew Valley, My Time at Portia, and A Short Hike, and the next to appear is the recently-released Ale and Tale Tavern, which is smashing it on Steam right now.

notes.title: Sandbox management game Ale and Tale Tavern gets co-op Steam demo
notes.notes:
While Stardew Valley and its fellow farming games are a delight, there's something special about seeing others enjoy the end product of your labors, and the tavern management sim is a great solution. Alongside the likes of Travellers Rest and the upcoming Tavern Keeper, we've even seen the likes of turn-based RPG Wartales step into the management game. But if you want to bring your friends along, Ale and Tale Tavern might be just what you're looking for, and a demo available now as a free Steam game is already proving popular.

notes.title: Update 1.0.5 Changelog
notes.notes:
1. Fixed a bug where non-interactive dishes were left by tavern visitors during enemy attacks.
2. Added a mode for simplified dishwashing. For those who have already installed the game and want to play with this mode, you need to check the corresponding box in the game settings. This mode allows you to wash dishes much faster.
3. A torch can now be purchased in the shop (after completing the "serve 3 dishes" quest).
4. Zombies now have less health, making their attacks less dangerous but still as unexpected.
5. Added a notification that the game has been saved.
6. When discarding ingredients from kitchen devices, they return to the inventory.
7. Mushrooms have become less valuable in the game. Boar steak can now be cooked without mushrooms.
8. Added a slider to adjust the dead zone of controllers. This prevents gamepads with some stick drift from intercepting game controls.
9. A connected gamepad will now only work after pressing any button on it. This solves the problem with connected steering wheels and flight sticks. Only after this will the game switch to gamepad control. At the same time, keyboard and mouse controls remain available. Reminder: the gamepad and keyboard + mouse work simultaneously without any special settings.
10. Fixed a bug where poison and spider slow effects carried over to the player after respawning.
11. Fixed an issue with the prologue completion popup window. This window now only appears once when completing the prologue. If closed (ESC or TAB), the window will not appear again, and you can continue playing.
12. Some improvements to overall balance, animations, lighting, and localization.
